items: Identity Integrations (SSPR, Azure AD, LDAP, Google Workspace)
Secure Automation for DevOps & CI/CD Tools

bio.title: Platform Security & Software Engineer
paragraphs: I’m Abishek VP, a software engineer specializing in platform security, identity integrations, and automation engineering. I work on building secure backend components, IAM workflows, and developer-friendly automation that simplifies authentication, directory management, and operational infrastructure.

I gained hands-on experience with SSPR, Azure AD/LDAP/Google Workspace integrations, directory sync, SCIM provisioning, and secure password workflows through real product implementations at Securden. I also build automation plugins for DevOps teams—covering Terraform, Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet—for securely fetching and managing credentials in CI/CD pipelines.

My engineering journey spans backend development, integrations engineering, full-stack projects, and internal platform tools across multiple organizations. I enjoy solving problems around identity automation, secure communication flows, and reliable system design.
Outside work, I build tools, explore automation workflows, and mentor peers in software and security engineering.
